visualCharacteristics: A small horizontal breadcrumb trail starting with a home glyph, followed by linked ancestor pages and the unlinked current page.
contentPattern: One cell with a list, one item per level: the first item is the home link (its text becomes the accessible name), linked items are ancestors and the unlinked last item is the current page.
usage: Use under the hero or sub navigation to show where the page sits in the site hierarchy.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on every content page that needs a trail; pick light, tall, close or xxl to match the band colour and spacing rather than styling a new block.
